programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Formula 1: Grand price of Azerbaijan / Formel 1: GroSSer Preis von Aserbaidschan
programme.desc: The Grand Prize of Azerbaijan takes place on a city course in Baku, which is called "Baku City Circuit". He has been in the racing calendar since 2017. There are 20 curves on the six-kilometer round and a 2.2 kilometer long straight, on which the Formula 1 racing cars can be accelerated to just under 360 km/h. In 2017, Sebastian Vettel set up a phanomenal round record with 1: 43.441. / Der GroSSe Preis von Aserbaidschan findet auf einem Stadtkurs in Baku statt, der "Baku City Circuit" genannt wird. Er ist seit 2017 im Rennkalender. Auf der sechs Kilometer langen Runde gibt es 20 Kurven und eine 2,2 Kilometer lange Gerade, auf der die Formel-1-Rennwagen auf knappe 360 km/h beschleunigt werden konnen. 2017 stellte Sebastian Vettel mit 1:43.441 einen phanomenalen Rundenrekord auf.

programme.title: Das Yoga-Magazin
programme.desc: Relax, meditate, find yourself and all of this in the home living room _ The "Yoga magazine" makes it possible. Competent and likeable yoga trainers show the best exercises to switch off. The show does not only report from the television studio. Often the programs are recorded in a very special location _ for example in Ibiza. / Entspannen, meditieren, zu sich selbst finden und das alles im heimischen Wohnzimmer _ das "Yoga-Magazin" macht es moglich. Kompetente und sympathische Yogatrainer zeigen die besten Übungen zum Abschalten. Die Sendung meldet sich ubrigens nicht nur aus dem Fernsehstudio. Oftmals werden die Sendungen in einer ganz besonderen Location aufgenommen _ zum Beispiel auf Ibiza.

programme.title: "We move Austria" school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - England 2. League / Fudbal - Engleska 2. liga
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond multimillionaire contracts and glittering bright media popularity is the Championship, an English league that it used to be. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams in the fight for the world, entering the Premiership. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svijetla medijske popularnosti smjestio se Championship, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posjećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svijetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premiership.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Italian Cup / Fudbal - Italijanski kup
programme.desc: The Italian Cup creates its history since 1922. and the first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they had to wait until 1936. When the competition began again and maintained each year. A somewhat curious fact is a smaller attendance of the stadium in relation to the "series of A" due to the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, everything comes down to water when the tournament is completed when the winner is guaranteed a safe place in the UEFA Europa League group. Then the interest in this competition increases abruptly. The real fan of Italian football will surely follow this competition! / Talijanski kup stvara svoju istoriju od 1922. i prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej ekipe sa Apeninskog poluostrva morale su čekati do 1936. kada je takmičenje ponovo počelo i održavalo se svake godine. Pomalo znatiželjna činjenica je manja posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na "Seriju A" zbog tradicije odmaranja najboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih ekipa. Međutim, sve se svodi na vodu kad se turnir završi kada pobjedniku bude zajamčeno sigurno mjesto u grupi UEFA Europa lige. Tada se zanimanje za ovo takmičenje naglo povećava. Pravi navijač italijanskog fudbala sigurno će pratiti ovo takmičenje!

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Poland League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league of Poland. The first league of Poland in football was founded in 1927. years, and the League organizes the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of the Polish Champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football: English EFL Cup / Fudbal: Engleski EFL kup
programme.desc: The Cup League Unlike your popular "brother" Fa Cup is starting its history in the 1960s and centuries and time using the possibility of playing under the spotlights in evening hours as soon as possible. All matches are playing in the middle of the week until the only final plays on a single match on the neutral field at Vembla Stadium in London. The interestingness of this competition is that the final is played in February or March, and the winner is secured by a placement in the UEFA Europa League if it has not already secured the placement through Premieršip. The first winners of the competition were the Footballers Aston Villas in 1961. Years. / Engleski Liga kup za razliku od svog popularnijeg "brata" FA kupa svoju istoriju započinje 60-tih godina 20. veka i time koristeći mogućnost igranja pod reflektorima u večernje sate što pre nije bilo moguće. Sve utakmice se igraju usred sedmice dok se jedino finale igra na jednu utakmicu na neutralnom terenu na stadionu Vembli u Londonu. Zanimljivost ovog takmičenja je da se finale igra već u februaru ili martu, a pobednik osigurava plasman u UEFA Ligi Evrope ukoliko već nije osigurao plasman kroz Premieršip. Prvi pobednici takmičenja su bili fudbaleri Aston Vile 1961. godine.

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Andon Nikolov / Зала на славата: Андон Николов
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Classic Style, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Класически стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.title: Blood / Кръвен баща
programme.desc: After an old and unproven sentence, John Link tries to stay away from the trouble - he lives isolated in the vicinity of Los Angeles and draws tattoos. It is as if nothing can shake him anymore, but a phone call brings him back in reality. His daughter, Lydia, with whom they have lost a relationship in the years, is in danger. Her friend is confused in trading with a Mexican drug cartel, their account does not go out, the dealers are chasing Linda, and she has already committed a murder. / След стара и недоказана присъда Джон Линк се опитва да стои далеч от неприятностите - живее изолирано в околностите на Лос Анджелис и рисува татуировки. Сякаш нищо вече не може да го разклати, но едно телефонно обаждане го връща бързо в действителността. Дъщеря му Лидия, с която са загубили връзка в годините, е в опасност. Приятелят й е забъркан в търговия с мексикански наркокартел, сметката им не излиза, дилърите преследват Линда, а тя вече е извършила убийство.

programme.title: Blood / Кръвен баща
programme.desc: After an old and unproven sentence, John Link tries to stay away from the trouble - he lives isolated in the vicinity of Los Angeles and draws tattoos. It is as if nothing can shake him anymore, but a phone call brings him back in reality. His daughter, Lydia, with whom they have lost a relationship in the years, is in danger. Her friend is confused in trading with a Mexican drug cartel, their account does not go out, the dealers are chasing Linda, and she has already committed a murder. / След стара и недоказана присъда Джон Линк се опитва да стои далеч от неприятностите - живее изолирано в околностите на Лос Анджелис и рисува татуировки. Сякаш нищо вече не може да го разклати, но едно телефонно обаждане го връща бързо в действителността. Дъщеря му Лидия, с която са загубили връзка в годините, е в опасност. Приятелят й е забъркан в търговия с мексикански наркокартел, сметката им не излиза, дилърите преследват Линда, а тя вече е извършила убийство.

programme.title: Wolf totem / Вълчи тотем
programme.desc: In 1967, the Cultural Revolution in China was in full swing. Student Chen Jun, along with his colleagues, arrives from Beijing to educate the Mongol nomads. The party orders the newborn wolves to be killed, but he attaches to them and secretly saves a little wolf and takes care of him. The boss Bao entrusted the army horses to the nomads, but the horses freeze in an ice lake, put there by the wolf pack left without food. The gazelles that the wolves keep are stolen by speculators. The nomads are slowly pushed and losing their land. The wolves were killed. Chen John's wolf is growing and released. Chen Jun wrote a book that became the most read after Mao Zedong's "Little Red Book". / През 1967 година културната революция в Китай е в разгара си. Студентът Чън Джън, заедно със свои колеги, пристига от Пекин, за да образова монголските номади. Партията издава заповед новородените вълчета да бъдат убивани, но той се привързва към тях и тайно спасява малко вълче и се грижи за него. Началникът Бао поверява армейските коне на номадите, но конете замръзват в ледено езеро, вкарани там от вълчата глутница, която е останала без храна. Газелите, които вълците пазят, са откраднати от спекуланти. Полека номадите са изтласкани и губят земите си. Вълците са избити. Вълчето на Чън Джън пораства и е пуснато на свобода. Чън Джън написва книга, която става най-четената след "Малката червена книга" на Мао Дзедун.

programme.desc: Coppa Italia - (Sport. Program, Italy, 2025) The Italian Cup has been tailoring its history since 1922 and its first edition. For the next trophy of the team from the Apennine Peninsula, they should have waited until 1936 when the competition began to be held again and held every year. A bit of a curiosity data is a weaker attendance of the stadium over Serie A because of the tradition of resting the best players of the strongest Italian teams. However, all this falls into the water during the end of the tournament when the winner is secured a safe place in the UEFA Europa League groups. Then interest in this competition is growing rapidly. A real fan of Italian football will surely accompany this competition! ... / Coppa Italia - (sport. program, Italija, 2025) Talijanski kup svoju povijest kroji od 1922. godine i svog prvog izdanja. Za naredni trofej momčadi sa Apeninskog poluotoka su trebali pričekati do 1936. godine kada se natjecanje opet počelo održavati i održava se svake godine. Pomalo kuriozitetan podatak je slabija posjećenost stadiona u odnosu na Serie A zbog tradicije odmaranja ponajboljih igrača najjačih talijanskih momčadi. No, sve to pada u vodu prilikom završnice turnira kada se pobjedniku osigurava sigurno mjesto u skupinama UEFA Europa lige. Tada interes za ovo natjecanje rapidno raste. programme.desc: Italian Serie A: Highlights - (Sport. Program, Italy) Serie A is a professional football competition that has 20 teams in the two -round league championship. With the fall of the financial power of the Italian first -team players and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality, but returns safe steps to the place where it belongs. ... / Italian Serie A: Highlights - (sport. program, Italija) Serie A profesionalno je nogometno natjecanje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Dugi niz godina talijanski se nogomet svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Europi. Padom financijske moći talijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada. ...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Sesvete - Jarun, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 7th round / Sesvete - Jarun, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 7. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Lokomotiva - Varaždin, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 7th round / Lokomotiva - Varaždin, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 7. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.desc: Lotta is ten years old and all her passion applies to Sumo rings, an old Japanese combat tradition. Sumo helps her to be confident and not only in the ring with both legs, but in life. Through sport, Lotta and the other children have learned to accept each other and above all. They encounter stressful situations more relaxed and breeding are undermined and avoided. Sumo is a sport for body and spirit. Lotta fell in love with the fascinating world of Sumo rings. Durch den Sport haben Lotta und die anderen Kinder gelernt, sich gegenseitig und vor allem sich selbst zu akzeptieren. Stresssituationen begegnen sie gelassener und Einschuchterungen werden ausgehebelt und umgangen. Sumo ist ein Sport fur Korper und Geist. programme.title: Oktoberfest Trachten and Guardie Zug 2025 / Oktoberfest Trachten- und Schutzenzug 2025
programme.desc: Not only for the approximately 9,000 participants is the traditional traditional costume and protection train on the first Wiesn Sunday a high point of the Oktoberfest season, but also for numerous television viewers in Germany and all over the world that can experience the event on the screen. Word of the "Munchner Kindl", move festively dressed costume groups, sports and mountain rudes, music bands, Spielmanns and fanfarenzug in an approximately seven-kilometer train across the Theresienwiese across Munch. They are accompanied by the magnificent horse breakdowns of the Munchner breweries, which are drawn by fine cold blooders, and many caps and feasts, on which old craft and Bavarian customs are shown. The participants come not only from all over Bavaria, but also from other federal countries and neighboring European countries. In 2025, a delegation from the United States was bordered as a highlight, where the descendants of Bavarian immigrants are still active in many traditional costumes. The "Gebirgrachtenverein Almrausch" in Philadelphia celebrates its 100-year existence and comes with around 100 members. / Nicht nur fur die rund 9.000 Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer ist der traditionelle Trachten- und Schutzenzug am ersten Wiesn-Sonntag ein Hohepunkt der Oktoberfest-Saison, sondern auch fur zahlreiche Fernsehzuschauer in Deutschland und aller Welt, die das Ereignis am Bildschirm miterleben konnen. Angefuhrt vom "Munchner Kindl", ziehen festlich gekleidete Trachtengruppen, Sport- und Gebirgsschutzen, Musikkapellen, Spielmanns- und Fanfarenzuge in einem rund sieben Kilometer langen Zug quer durch die Munchner Innenstadt auf die Theresienwiese. Begleitet werden sie von den prachtigen Pferdegespannen der Munchner Brauereien, die von edlen Kaltblutern gezogen werden, und vielen Festkutschen und Festwagen, auf denen altes Handwerk und bayerisches Brauchtum gezeigt wird. Die Teilnehmenden kommen nicht nur aus ganz Bayern, sondern auch aus anderen Bundeslandern und europaischen Nachbarstaaten. Als Highlight hat sich 2025 eine Delegation aus den USA angekundigt, wo die Nachkommen von bayerischen Einwanderern bis heute in vielen Trachtenvereinen aktiv sind. Der "Gebirgstrachtenverein Almrausch" in Philadelphia feiert sein 100-jahriges Bestehen und kommt er mit rund 100 Mitgliedern.

programme.title: Police call 110 / Polizeiruf 110
programme.sub-title: You are among us / Sie sind unter uns
programme.desc: Major deployment of the police at a Magdeburg school. The 17-year-old Jeremy (Mikke Rasch) runs amok. He has already shot two people. Now he is entrenched himself in a fully occupied classroom and takes the schools and her teacher (Tanya Erartsin) as hostage. Under high pressure, Brasch begins to find out more about Jeremy. Her investigation drove to Jeremy's home, where she meets his single mother Rebecca (Maja Beckmann). Rebecca is largely tied to bed due to its MS disease. It is dependent on Jeremy's care and his support. She doesn't want to have noticed anything about his radicalization and the meticulous preparations for the killing spree. How could it happen that Jeremy's change was unnoticed? Why did Jeremy become a gauge? Did he act alone or does he have accomplice? Brasch is faced with the difficult task of deciding Jeremy's motivations, moving it to the task and preventing other fatalities. / GroSSeinsatz der Polizei an einer Magdeburger Schule. Der 17-jahrige Jeremy (Mikke Rasch) lauft Amok. Zwei Menschen hat er bereits erschossen. Jetzt verschanzt er sich in einem voll besetzten Klassenraum und nimmt die Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie ihre Lehrerin (Tanya Erartsin) als Geiseln.Unter Hochdruck beginnt Brasch, mehr uber Jeremy herauszufinden. Ihre Ermittlungen fuhren sie zu Jeremys Zuhause, wo sie seine alleinerziehende Mutter Rebecca (Maja Beckmann) trifft. Rebecca ist aufgrund ihrer MS-Erkrankung groSStenteils ans Bett gefesselt. Sie ist auf Jeremys Pflege und seine Unterstutzung angewiesen. Von seiner Radikalisierung und den akribischen Vorbereitungen zum Amoklauf will sie nichts mitbekommen haben.Wie konnte es passieren, dass Jeremys Veranderung unbemerkt blieb? Warum wurde Jeremy zum Amoklaufer? Handelte er allein oder hat er Komplizen? Brasch steht vor der schwierigen Aufgabe, Jeremys Motivationen zu entschlusseln, ihn zur Aufgabe zu bewegen und weitere Todesopfer zu verhindern.

programme.title: Caren Miosga
programme.sub-title: Trump divides the United States - what damage does democracy take? / Trump spaltet die USA - welchen Schaden nimmt die Demokratie?
programme.desc: Die politische Lage in den USA ist angespannt: Nach dem Mord an dem Polit-Aktivisten Charlie Kirk und Angriffen der Trump-Administration auf die Pressefreiheit steht das Vertrauen in die Standhaftigkeit der Demokratie auf dem Spiel. Der Unionsfraktionsvorsitzende und Transatlantiker Jens Spahn vertritt bislang einen pragmatischen Kurs gegenuber US-Prasident Trump und erkennt Überschneidungen mit deutschen Positionen - etwa in Verteidigungsfragen, der Energiepolitik und im Umgang mit China. Welche Lehren lassen sich aus der derzeitigen US-Politik ziehen? Und welche Auswirkungen haben populistische Bewegungen auf die Stabilitat demokratischer Systeme - auch in Deutschland?

Er geht brutal vor, seine Opfer wahlt er zufallig. Manchmal missbraucht er die Frauen erst nach ihrem Tod. Danach entsorgt er sie wie Mull. "Es war sein Ziel, sie sexuell zu missbrauchen. Und ihm war es dann egal, ob sie tot war, bewusstlos - Hauptsache, er konnte uber sie verfugen", sagt Kriminalpsychologin Dr. Gilda Giebel.Seine Tatorte sind Koln, Moers, Dillenburg und Kassel, meist nahe Autobahnen. Er ist immer in Bewegung, bleibt lange unbehelligt.Fruh deuten Spuren auf einen Lkw-Fahrer mit festen Routen hin. Doch die verschiedenen Tatorte in unterschiedlichen Bundeslandern erschweren den Fall. Statt zusammenzuarbeiten, agieren die SOKOS getrennt. Die foderale Struktur behindert den Austausch. Auch der Datenschutz bremst die Ermittlungen: Das Mautsystem, welches die Kennzeichen aller Lkw-Fahrer erfasst, konnte helfen, doch die Betreiberfirma darf die Daten nicht herausgeben. Jeder neue Tatort bringt neue Ermittler, neue Akten, neue Fragen. Nur eines bleibt gleich: der Tater.Nach der Aussage des einzigen uberlebenden Opfers kann ein Phantombild erstellt werden - doch der entscheidende Hinweis fehlt. Es kommt zu weiteren Morden. Im Oktober 2005 verschwindet eine Frau in Dillenburg und wird 30 Kilometer entfernt tot in einem Wald entdeckt. Keine brauchbaren DNA-Spuren, ein Zusammenhang wird nicht erkannt. Als neun Monate spater in Kassel eine Schulerin verschleppt und ermordet wird, kommt Bewegung in den Fall. Ein DNA-Abgleich zeigt: Die Taten in Kassel, Koln und Moers hangen zusammen. Doch der Tater bleibt ein Phantom. Er ist nicht registriert.Nur kurze Zeit spater bringt ein Zufall die Wende: Eine winzige Hautschuppe am BH des Opfers aus Dillenburg liefert den entscheidenden Beweis: Es ist auch hier ein und derselbe Tater. Sein Phantombild aus Koln wird erneut veroffentlicht - dieses Mal auch in Hessen. Zwei Hinweise fuhren zu Marco M. - einem unauffalligen Familienvater aus dem mittelhessischen Haiger. Der Mann lasst sich widerstandslos festnehmen. Seine Taten gesteht er emotionslos: Er wisse auch nicht warum, es sei einfach uber ihn gekommen.Im Juni 2007 verurteilt das Landgericht Limburg Marco M., bekannt als "Brummi-Morder", zu lebenslanger Haft mit anschlieSSender Sicherungsverwahrung. Das psychiatrische Gutachten bescheinigt ihm volle Schuldfahigkeit - und eine extrem hohe Gewaltbereitschaft.

programme.title: Bay, bricks, polka - the Bohemian Vienna / Buchteln, Ziegeln, Polka - Das bohmische Wien
programme.desc: Vienna around 1900 has a Bohemian face: Czech aristocracy, burger, the so-called "brickbohm" and cookesses the former Habsburg metropolis to this day. From Czech-Bohmischen Stadtpalais, craft businesses, whether Schneider or Schuster, up to coffee house: There is a far-reaching Czech infrastructure in Vienna. Music and especially her eating culture also influence the life of the big city. It is the life stories of cookers who combine with city stories and city walks. Whether in the magnificent palace, in Bohemian Prater, in long -established taverns, at the bricks or in the Belvedere Castle, there are refusions to the Bohemian Kuche and the people behind it. The turn of the century had a high Czech stipulation. Dienstmadchen or as chefs. Numerous recipes from the Bohemian Kuche find their way into the Wiener Kuche. In addition, the bays, livets, knodels, sussels sussen as well as Czech beer as nutritious pay. Few know that behind this traditional Viennese confectionery is a Czech story. There are still a few of the old, Bohemian recipes, and a bohemian classic is still offered at the sausage stand: the clobe, a rooted sausage specialty from the Czech Republic. The "Prague ham" is also based. The recipe in Vienna already maintains a butcher shop in the Funften Generation. In addition, mustard and inserted gem is served and who grilled pork knuckles is preferred in Vienna at the literature known from the literature. He made a name for himself in Vienna with juicy, crispy stilts, with Czech beer. Numerous Czech cultural associations, music ensembles and a Czech school are still established in Vienna and their culture is clearly part of the Viennese identity. A documentation by Anita Lackenberger / Wien um 1900 hat ein bohmisches Gesicht: tschechische Aristokratie, Burgertum, die sogenannten "Ziegelbohm" und Kochinnen pragen die einstige Habsburgermetropole bis heute.Vom tschechisch-bohmischen Stadtpalais, Handwerksbetrieben, ob Schneider oder Schuster, bis hin zu Kaffeehausern: in Wien gibt es eine weitreichende tschechische Infrastruktur. Genauso beeinflussen Musik und insbesondere ihre Esskultur das Leben der GroSSstadt.Die Regisseurin Anita Lackenberger ladt zu einer Spurensuche nach dem vergessenen bohmischen Erbe Wiens. Es sind die Lebensgeschichten von Kochinnen, die sich mit Stadtgeschichten und Stadtspaziergangen verbinden. Ob in den prachtigen Palais, im Bohmischen Prater, in alteingesessenen Wirtshausern, bei den Ziegelteichen oder im Schloss Belvedere, uberall finden sich Bezuge zur bohmischen Kuche und den dahinterstehenden Menschen.Um die Jahrhundertwende hatte Wien einen hohen tschechischen Bevolkerungsanteil.Neben den Arbeitern in den Ziegelwerken im Suden der Stadt sind viele Frauen in den Stadtpalais als Ammen, Dienstmadchen oder als Kochinnen im Einsatz. So finden zahlreiche Rezepte aus der bohmischen Kuche Eingang in die Wiener Kuche. Dazu zahlen die Buchteln, Liwanzen, Knodel, suSSe SoSSen zum Braten genauso wie das tschechische Bier als nahrhaftes Getrank.Damals wie heute trifft man sich, vor allem wenn es "wienerisch" sein soll, in der Konditorei Aida. Nur wenige wissen, dass sich hinter dieser Wiener Traditionskonditorei eine tschechische Geschichte verbirgt. Ein paar der alten, bohmischen Rezepte gibt es noch.Selbst beim Wurstelstand wird noch heute ein bohmischer Klassiker angeboten: die Klobasse, eine wurzige Wurstspezialitat aus Tschechien. Beruhmt ist auch der "Prager Schinken". Die Rezeptur pflegt in Wien eine Fleischerei bereits in der funften Generation. Dazu serviert wird Senf und eingelegtes Gemuse.Und wer Schweinshaxen gegrillt bevorzugt wird in Wien beim aus der Literatur bekannten Herrn Kolarik fundig. Er hat sich in Wien mit saftig, knusprigen Stelzen, serviert mit tschechischem Bier, einen Namen gemacht.Die tschechische Diaspora in Wien hat eine lange Geschichte, auch nach dem Zuzug um 1900. Das wechselvolle 20. Jahrhundert hat Wien oft zur Zufluchtsstatte werden lassen. Zahlreiche tschechische Kulturvereine, Musikensembles sowie eine tschechische Schule sind in Wien bis heute etabliert und deren Kultur ist deutlich bis heute Teil der Wiener Identitat.Eine Dokumentation von Anita Lackenberger

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the trace of traces of the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions, to illuminate his facilities and to recognize his grade. Fur Prince Eugen was nothing too expensive and seemingly nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. He wanted to continue realizing his dreams in Hof Castle and he managed to calm down in a age in which others have long calmed down. When Prince Eugen Schloss Hof acquired Hof, he was 62 years old. He commissioned the architect Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt to build a repressant hunting seat from the lucky Renaissance kastell with a rectangular floor plan. So a building was built on the landing of Castle Hof in a short time that no wish left open. The castle was delivered to the west around two flight buildings. Until the death of Prince Eugens, over 800 craftsmen were also bustled with seven terraces. For the exquisite equipment of the palace rooms - on the first floor there were Prince Eugen's residential apartment, the parade apartment, 13 guest room, the chapel and the ballroom - those artists who had already earned in the Belvedere castle were already involved. Among them were the interior decorator Claude Le Fort Du Plessy and the plasterers Santino Bussi and Alberto Camesina. A special exhibition is dedicated to the 300-year existence of Hof in the Baroque Castle Hof and also in the Lower Weiden Castle in his design by Prince Eugen. The "Eugen behind the Prince" is also illuminated. The rapid rise of Eugen as a general and war minister, the many facets of the brilliant networker and manic collector, his role at the center of an elite group of friends and arts and the prompt shape of the Esterreichian baroque. How did the prince get to all the exotic plants and animals, to the exquisite fabrics and ceramics, where does his thousands of bookers come from, what drove him to deal with philosophy? In 1736, Prince Eugen died in the 73rd year of life childless before the final completion of his Castle Hof, his inheritance is now accessible to all visitor of the impressive castle. / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen.Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter verwirklichen und es gelang ihm in einem Lebensalter, in dem sich andere langst zur Ruhe gesetzt haben. Als Prinz Eugen Schloss Hof erwarb, war er 62 Jahre alt. Er beauftragte den Architekten Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt aus dem einstockigen Renaissancekastell mit rechteckigem Grundriss einen reprasentativen Jagdsitz zu errichten. So entstand am Gelande von Schloss Hof in kurzester Zeit ein Gebaude, das keine Wunsche offenlieSS. Das Schloss wurde um zwei Flugelbauten nach Westen hin verlangert. Über 800 Handwerker waren bis zum Tode Prinz Eugens unter anderem auch damit beschaftigt, einen weitlaufigen Garten mit sieben Terrassen anzulegen. Fur die exquisite Ausstattung der Schlossraume - im ersten Stock befanden sich Prinz Eugens Wohnappartement, das Paradeappartement, 13 Gastezimmer, die Kapelle und der Festsaal - wurden jene Kunstler engagiert, die sich bereits unter anderem in den Belvedere Schlossern verdient gemacht hatten. Darunter waren der Innendekorateur Claude Le Fort du Plessy sowie die Stuckateure Santino Bussi und Alberto Camesina.Eine Sonderausstellung widmet sich im barocken Schloss Hof und auch im Schloss Niederweiden dem 300-jahrigen Bestehen von Schloss Hof in seiner Gestaltung durch Prinz Eugen. Dabei wird auch der "Eugen hinter dem Prinzen" beleuchtet. Der rasante Aufstieg Eugens als Feldherr und Kriegsminister, die vielen Facetten des brillanten Netzwerkers und manischen Sammlers, seine Rolle im Mittelpunkt eines elitaren Freundes- und Kunstlerkreises und die pragende Gestalt des osterreichischen Barocks. Wie kam der Prinz zu all den exotischen Pflanzen und Tieren, zu den erlesenen Stoffen und Keramiken, woher stammt seine tausende Bucher umfassende Bibliothek, was trieb ihn an, sich mit Philosophie zu beschaftigen?1736 stirbt Prinz Eugen im 73. Lebensjahr kinderlos noch vor der endgultigen Vollendung seines Schloss Hof Traums, sein Erbe ist heute allen Besuchern der beeindruckenden Schlossanlage zuganglich.

In Hintertux gibt es ein altes Thermalbad, das noch in Betrieb ist. Interessant ist die Geschichte eines Bauern aus Navis, der vor 50 Jahren in einem der ersten "Österreich Bilder" zu sehen war.

programme.title: Menschen and Machte
programme.sub-title: Recht nicht Rache. Der Zeitzeuge Simon Wiesenthal
programme.desc: On September 20th, Simon Wiesenthal's annual day of death. He was more than the much -cited Nazi hunter. He was a "guard of memory". And it is precisely this reminder of the memory of the Holocaust for Simon Wiesenthal did not have an expiry date. For decades, Wiesenthal claimed Austria's commitment to joint responsibility for the crimes of National Socialism. As a contemporary witness of Jewish suffering, he became a moral conscience against racism and hostility to foreigners. In his books and presentation, he wanted to convey the networked connection between the past, present and the future. / Am 20. September jahrt sich zum 20. Mal der Todestag von Simon Wiesenthal. Er war mehr als der vielzitierte Nazijager. Er war ein "Wachter der Erinnerung". Und eben dieses Wachhalten der Erinnerung an den Holocaust besaSS fur Simon Wiesenthal kein Ablaufdatum. Jahrzehntelang forderte Wiesenthal das Bekenntnis Österreichs zur Mitverantwortung an den Verbrechen des Nationalsozialismus ein. Als Zeitzeuge des judischen Leidens wurde er zum moralischen Gewissen gegen Rassismus und Auslanderfeindlichkeit. In seinen Buchern und Vortragen wollte er vor allem der Jugend die vernetzten Zusammenhange zwischen Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft vermitteln.Eine Dokumentation von Andreas Novak

programme.title: Bay, bricks, polka - the Bohemian Vienna / Buchteln, Ziegeln, Polka - Das bohmische Wien
programme.desc: Vienna around 1900 has a Bohemian face: Czech aristocracy, burger, the so-called "brickbohm" and cookesses the former Habsburg metropolis to this day. From Czech-Bohmischen Stadtpalais, craft businesses, whether Schneider or Schuster, up to coffee house: There is a far-reaching Czech infrastructure in Vienna. Music and especially her eating culture also influence the life of the big city. It is the life stories of cookers who combine with city stories and city walks. Whether in the magnificent palace, in Bohemian Prater, in long -established taverns, at the bricks or in the Belvedere Castle, there are refusions to the Bohemian Kuche and the people behind it. The turn of the century had a high Czech stipulation. Dienstmadchen or as chefs. Numerous recipes from the Bohemian Kuche find their way into the Wiener Kuche. In addition, the bays, livets, knodels, sussels sussen as well as Czech beer as nutritious pay. Few know that behind this traditional Viennese confectionery is a Czech story. There are still a few of the old, Bohemian recipes, and a bohemian classic is still offered at the sausage stand: the clobe, a rooted sausage specialty from the Czech Republic. The "Prague ham" is also based. The recipe in Vienna already maintains a butcher shop in the Funften Generation. In addition, mustard and inserted gem is served and who grilled pork knuckles is preferred in Vienna at the literature known from the literature. He made a name for himself in Vienna with juicy, crispy stilts, with Czech beer. Numerous Czech cultural associations, music ensembles and a Czech school are still established in Vienna and their culture is clearly part of the Viennese identity. A documentation by Anita Lackenberger / Wien um 1900 hat ein bohmisches Gesicht: tschechische Aristokratie, Burgertum, die sogenannten "Ziegelbohm" und Kochinnen pragen die einstige Habsburgermetropole bis heute.Vom tschechisch-bohmischen Stadtpalais, Handwerksbetrieben, ob Schneider oder Schuster, bis hin zu Kaffeehausern: in Wien gibt es eine weitreichende tschechische Infrastruktur. Genauso beeinflussen Musik und insbesondere ihre Esskultur das Leben der GroSSstadt.Die Regisseurin Anita Lackenberger ladt zu einer Spurensuche nach dem vergessenen bohmischen Erbe Wiens. Es sind die Lebensgeschichten von Kochinnen, die sich mit Stadtgeschichten und Stadtspaziergangen verbinden. Ob in den prachtigen Palais, im Bohmischen Prater, in alteingesessenen Wirtshausern, bei den Ziegelteichen oder im Schloss Belvedere, uberall finden sich Bezuge zur bohmischen Kuche und den dahinterstehenden Menschen.Um die Jahrhundertwende hatte Wien einen hohen tschechischen Bevolkerungsanteil.Neben den Arbeitern in den Ziegelwerken im Suden der Stadt sind viele Frauen in den Stadtpalais als Ammen, Dienstmadchen oder als Kochinnen im Einsatz. So finden zahlreiche Rezepte aus der bohmischen Kuche Eingang in die Wiener Kuche. Dazu zahlen die Buchteln, Liwanzen, Knodel, suSSe SoSSen zum Braten genauso wie das tschechische Bier als nahrhaftes Getrank.Damals wie heute trifft man sich, vor allem wenn es "wienerisch" sein soll, in der Konditorei Aida. Nur wenige wissen, dass sich hinter dieser Wiener Traditionskonditorei eine tschechische Geschichte verbirgt. Ein paar der alten, bohmischen Rezepte gibt es noch.Selbst beim Wurstelstand wird noch heute ein bohmischer Klassiker angeboten: die Klobasse, eine wurzige Wurstspezialitat aus Tschechien. Beruhmt ist auch der "Prager Schinken". Die Rezeptur pflegt in Wien eine Fleischerei bereits in der funften Generation. Dazu serviert wird Senf und eingelegtes Gemuse.Und wer Schweinshaxen gegrillt bevorzugt wird in Wien beim aus der Literatur bekannten Herrn Kolarik fundig. Er hat sich in Wien mit saftig, knusprigen Stelzen, serviert mit tschechischem Bier, einen Namen gemacht.Die tschechische Diaspora in Wien hat eine lange Geschichte, auch nach dem Zuzug um 1900. Das wechselvolle 20. Jahrhundert hat Wien oft zur Zufluchtsstatte werden lassen. Zahlreiche tschechische Kulturvereine, Musikensembles sowie eine tschechische Schule sind in Wien bis heute etabliert und deren Kultur ist deutlich bis heute Teil der Wiener Identitat.Eine Dokumentation von Anita Lackenberger

programme.title: Erlebnis Österreich
programme.sub-title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the trace of traces of the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions, to illuminate his facilities and to recognize his grade. Fur Prince Eugen was nothing too expensive and seemingly nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. He wanted to continue realizing his dreams in Hof Castle and he managed to calm down in a age in which others have long calmed down. When Prince Eugen Schloss Hof acquired Hof, he was 62 years old. He commissioned the architect Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt to build a repressant hunting seat from the lucky Renaissance kastell with a rectangular floor plan. So a building was built on the landing of Castle Hof in a short time that no wish left open. The castle was delivered to the west around two flight buildings. Until the death of Prince Eugens, over 800 craftsmen were also bustled with seven terraces. For the exquisite equipment of the palace rooms - on the first floor there were Prince Eugen's residential apartment, the parade apartment, 13 guest room, the chapel and the ballroom - those artists who had already earned in the Belvedere castle were already involved. Among them were the interior decorator Claude Le Fort Du Plessy and the plasterers Santino Bussi and Alberto Camesina. A special exhibition is dedicated to the 300-year existence of Hof in the Baroque Castle Hof and also in the Lower Weiden Castle in his design by Prince Eugen. The "Eugen behind the Prince" is also illuminated. The rapid rise of Eugen as a general and war minister, the many facets of the brilliant networker and manic collector, his role at the center of an elite group of friends and arts and the prompt shape of the Esterreichian baroque. How did the prince get to all the exotic plants and animals, to the exquisite fabrics and ceramics, where does his thousands of bookers come from, what drove him to deal with philosophy? In 1736, Prince Eugen died in the 73rd year of life childless before the final completion of his Castle Hof, his inheritance is now accessible to all visitor of the impressive castle. / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen.Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter verwirklichen und es gelang ihm in einem Lebensalter, in dem sich andere langst zur Ruhe gesetzt haben. Als Prinz Eugen Schloss Hof erwarb, war er 62 Jahre alt. Er beauftragte den Architekten Johann Lucas von Hildebrandt aus dem einstockigen Renaissancekastell mit rechteckigem Grundriss einen reprasentativen Jagdsitz zu errichten. So entstand am Gelande von Schloss Hof in kurzester Zeit ein Gebaude, das keine Wunsche offenlieSS. Das Schloss wurde um zwei Flugelbauten nach Westen hin verlangert. Über 800 Handwerker waren bis zum Tode Prinz Eugens unter anderem auch damit beschaftigt, einen weitlaufigen Garten mit sieben Terrassen anzulegen. Fur die exquisite Ausstattung der Schlossraume - im ersten Stock befanden sich Prinz Eugens Wohnappartement, das Paradeappartement, 13 Gastezimmer, die Kapelle und der Festsaal - wurden jene Kunstler engagiert, die sich bereits unter anderem in den Belvedere Schlossern verdient gemacht hatten. Darunter waren der Innendekorateur Claude Le Fort du Plessy sowie die Stuckateure Santino Bussi und Alberto Camesina.Eine Sonderausstellung widmet sich im barocken Schloss Hof und auch im Schloss Niederweiden dem 300-jahrigen Bestehen von Schloss Hof in seiner Gestaltung durch Prinz Eugen. Dabei wird auch der "Eugen hinter dem Prinzen" beleuchtet. Lebensjahr kinderlos noch vor der endgultigen Vollendung seines Schloss Hof Traums, sein Erbe ist heute allen Besuchern der beeindruckenden Schlossanlage zuganglich.

programme.title: kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: kulturMONTAG
programme.desc: War and peace can you talk about peace when wars are normality? Under the title "Never Again Peace", the 58th edition of the "Styrian Autumn" festival is devoted to an issue that could not be more current. Ernst Toller's anti -fascist satire "Never again peace", which was created in 1936, forms the starting point for numerous artistic projects on the past and today's conflicts. Dimitre calls Dinev "time of the brave", who fled from Bulgaria to Austria in 1990 is his opus magnum. It is a very personal billing with its former homeland, in which he traces the leading atmosphere in the former communist-fascist country and explores the history of Europe. Abuse of power, leaked chats, corruption scandals on theater stages? While the media landscape has been fighting for the trust of its readership for years, daily and social policy gradually conquers the boards that mean the world. Investigative research platforms such as "Dossier", "Therefore" or the "Institute for Media, Politics and Theater" put virulent topics in the spotlight. The "cultural monument" about the trend towards research theater. / Krieg and FriedenWie kann man uber Frieden reden, wenn Kriege Normalitat sind? Unter dem Titel "Never Again Peace" widmet sich die 58. Ausgabe des "steirischen herbst"-Festivals einem Thema, das aktueller nicht sein konnte. Ernst Tollers antifaschistische Satire "Nie wieder Friede", die 1936 entstanden ist bildet dabei den Ausgangspunkt fur zahlreiche kunstlerische Projekte zu den vergangenen wie heutigen Konflikten. "Zeit der Mutigen" nennt Dimitre Dinev, der 1990 aus Bulgarien nach Österreich geflohen ist sein Opus Magnum. Es ist eine sehr personliche Abrechnung mit seiner einstigen Heimat, in der er die bleierne Atmosphare in dem einstig kommunistisch-faschistischen Land nachzeichnet und dabei die Geschichte Europas erkundet. Machtmissbrauch, geleakte Chats, Korruptionsskandale auf Theaterbuhnen? Wahrend die Medienlandschaft seit Jahren um das Vertrauen ihrer Leserschaft kampft, erobert Tages- wie Gesellschaftspolitik sukzessive die Bretter, die die Welt bedeuten. Investigative Rechercheplattformen wie "Dossier", "Darum" oder das "Institut fur Medien, Politik und Theater" stellen virulente Themen ins Rampenlicht. Der "kulturMONTAG" uber den Trend zum Recherche-Theater.

programme.title: Sugar - Vater des Italo -blues / Zucchero - Vater des Italo-Blues
programme.desc: The film is a portrait of the legendary Italian singer, multi-instrumentalist Songwriters and Blues musicians Zucchero, which shows the exclusive footage from its private archives and its world tour and lets know well-known companions such as Bono, Sting and Andrea Bocelli.
