programme.sub-title: Anger - their power, their strength - and how we deal with it / Wut - ihre Macht, ihre Kraft - Und wie wir damit umgehen
programme.desc: Anger is everywhere. It can escalate and destroy. But our anger can be influenced. The psychologist Lukas Klaschinski hits people who move a little positively with their anger. But anger can also become a danger. The good thing: we don't have to be determined by her. A visit to Charite Berlin shows that we can train our brain like a muscle and thus our anger. Now he is on trial because of two, maybe for several years. But the young man wants to others. From the ultra scene, he has long for himself and is now looking for help from an association that helps men like him: Alex learns to find a healthy deal with his anger in the social counseling Stuttgart. For over 15 years, the association has only offered an anti -aggressive training training for men, 200 participants have already successfully completed it. Will Alex get the way out of violence? There are also people who cannot express their anger enough. This can also become a problem and even make it sick. Women in particular are often trained, nice and calm socially instead of startling and anger. Katrin is a mother of four and often doesn't know where to go with her anger in everyday life. She suppresses her feelings for too long to work as a mother - and finally the anger bursts out too much. Her wish is to find a way, to allow her anger to allow her to be a place in everyday life. To learn this, there are so -called industrious seminars, especially for women. Here Katrin learns new ways of anger. In the worst case in the form of real shitstorms, mass insults. The victims are particularly often women. Just like the swimming world champion Angelina Kohler (24). At the Olympic Games in Paris 2024, contrary to all expectations, she only took fourth place, indirectly accuses the third -placed doping in an interview and is then flooded with anger and hate comments. You still follow this traumatic experience. Angelina Kohler was exposed to anger alone, there are organizations that help people like her. Hateaid in Berlin represents victims of digital violence in advice and in court. Inwut is not a pure private matter. Also the anger at politics, awakening to social misery. This can be dangerous: the number of politically motivated crimes has rapidly increased in recent years. Political anger can also help to do things for the better. There is a ship in Spain, the crew of which does exactly that. The aid organization Sea-Watch has saved people in the Mediterranean since 2015 on the run. The German-Moroccan Eliora has been with the aid organization for a year and a half. Your reason: anger on social misstance. On politics. She has learned to convert her anger into something positive: she saves life. The documentation series "Plan B" shows what incredible strength is anger to harm us and what potential to help us and others. / Wut ist uberall. Sie kann eskalieren und zerstoren. Doch unsere Wut lasst sich beeinflussen. Der Psychologe Lukas Klaschinski trifft Menschen, die mit ihrer Wut etwas Positiv bewegen.Jeder von uns wird mal wutend, das ist ganz naturlich. Aber Wut kann auch zur Gefahr werden. Das Gute: Wir mussen uns von ihr nicht bestimmen lassen. Ein Besuch in der Charite Berlin zeigt: Wir konnen unser Gehirn trainieren wie einen Muskel und damit auch unsere Wut.Alex (Name geandert) war jahrelang in der FuSSball-Ultraszene aktiv, ist dort immer wieder gewalttatig geworden. Jetzt steht er wegen zwei Vorfallen vor Gericht, muss vielleicht fur mehrere Jahre ins Gefangnis. Doch der junge Mann will sich andern. Aus der Ultraszene hat er sich losgesagt und sucht nun Hilfe bei einem Verein, der Mannern wie ihm hilft: In der Sozialberatung Stuttgart lernt Alex, einen gesunden Umgang mit seiner Wut zu finden. Seit uber 15 Jahren bietet der Verein ein Antiaggressivitatstraining nur fur Manner an, 200 Teilnehmer haben es schon erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Wird Alex den Weg aus der Gewalt schaffen?Es gibt auch Menschen, die ihre Wut nicht genug zum Ausdruck bringen konnen. Das kann ebenfalls zum Problem werden und sogar krank machen. Gerade Frauen wird gesellschaftlich oft antrainiert, nett und ruhig zu sein, statt aufbrausend und wutend. Katrin ist vierfache Mutter und weiSS im Alltag oft nicht, wohin mit ihrer Wut. Zu lange unterdruckt sie ihre Gefuhle, um als Mutter zu funktionieren - und schlieSSlich platzt die Wut zu stark aus ihr heraus. Ihr Wunsch ist es, einen Weg zu finden, ihre Wut fruher zuzulassen und ihr einen Platz im Alltag einzuraumen. Um das zu lernen, gibt es sogenannte Wutseminare, speziell fur Frauen. Hier lernt Katrin neue Wege der Wutbewaltigung.Besonders ungehemmt begegnet uns Wut dort, wo viele von uns taglich unterwegs sind: im Internet. Im schlimmsten Fall in Form von regelrechten Shitstorms, massenhaften Beleidigungen. Besonders oft sind die Opfer Frauen. So wie die Schwimmweltmeisterin Angelina Kohler (24). Bei den Olympischen Spielen in Paris 2024 belegt sie - entgegen allen Erwartungen - nur den vierten Platz, wirft der Drittplatzierten in einem Interview indirekt Doping vor und wird daraufhin mit Wut und Hasskommentaren regelrecht uberschwemmt. Diese traumatische Erfahrung hangt ihr bis heute nach. Angelina Kohler war der Wut allein ausgesetzt, dabei gibt es Organisationen, die Menschen wie ihr helfen. HateAid in Berlin vertritt Opfer digitaler Gewalt in Beratungen und vor Gericht.Wut ist keine reine Privatangelegenheit. Auch die Wut auf die Politik, auf gesellschaftliche Missstande wachst. Das kann gefahrlich werden: Die Zahl der politisch motivierten Straftaten ist in den letzten Jahren rapide angestiegen. Politische Wut kann aber auch dazu beitragen, Dinge zum Guten zu verandern. In Spanien liegt ein Schiff, dessen Besatzung genau das tut. Die Hilfsorganisation Sea-Watch rettet seit 2015 im Mittelmeer Menschen auf der Flucht, die in Seenot geraten. Die Deutsch-Marokkanerin Eliora ist seit anderthalb Jahren bei der Hilfsorganisation. Ihr Grund: Wut auf gesellschaftliche Missstande. Auf die Politik. Sie hat gelernt, ihre Wut in etwas Positives umzuwandeln: Sie rettet Leben.Die Dokumentationsreihe "plan b" zeigt, welch unglaubliche Kraft Wut besitzt, uns zu schaden und welches Potenzial, uns und anderen zu helfen.

programme.title: Nachtwache
programme.desc: For a law student, the position as a night watchman in forensic medicine seems to be the ideal part -time job. But then there is an extraordinary eventful events. Scandinavian thriller classic of success director Ole Bornedal with Nikolaj Coster-Waldau. To finance his law studies, the 24-year Martin (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) takes up a job as a night watcher. The activity in the forensic medical department is simple and he can also prepare for his exam. There is still a good time that he can spend with his girlfriend Kalinka (Sofie Gråbøl), but so unexpectedly consecrated the night silence and the numerous corpses in the basement of the building nerve. The fact that this includes the victims of a serial killer who is now up to mischief in Copenhagen does not exactly improve his mood. In addition, his best friend Jens (Kim Bodnia) is bursting with crazed ideas. In addition to bizarre bets, he also remembered tasteless pranks that he can play his buddy. But not all disturbing events that occur in a row can be explained. And so Martin Splotich is targeted by Inspector Wormer (Ulf Pilgaard), who actually suspects him to be the murdered murder. The first work by the Danish director Ole Bornedal was the most successful movie in 1994 in his homeland and quickly became a real cult film internationally. A US remake with Ewan McGregor and Nick Nolte in the leading roles, which was also staged by Bornedal, had been followed for three years later. And in addition to Kim Bodnia as Jens and Ulf Pilgaard as a crime inspector, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau ("Game of Thrones", "Oblivion") is of course also part of the leading role. / Fur einen Jurastudenten scheint die Stelle als Nachtwachter in der Gerichtsmedizin der ideale Nebenjob zu sein. Doch dann haufen sich auSSerst beunruhigende Ereignisse.Die morbide Atmosphare, verruckte Einfalle seines Freundes und die Taten eines Serienmorders sorgen dafur, dass der junge Mann in einen Albtraum gerat. Skandinavischer Thrillerklassiker von Erfolgsregisseur Ole Bornedal mit Nikolaj Coster-Waldau.Um sein Jurastudium zu finanzieren, tritt der 24-jahrige Martin (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) eine Stelle als Nachtwachter an. Die Tatigkeit in der gerichtsmedizinischen Abteilung ist einfach, und er kann sich nebenbei auf sein Examen vorbereiten. Es bleibt auch noch genugend Zeit, die er mit seiner Freundin Kalinka (Sofie Gråbøl) verbringen kann.Doch vollig unerwartet zehren die nachtliche Stille und die zahlreichen Leichen im Keller des Gebaudes an Martins Nerven. Die Tatsache, dass sich darunter die Opfer eines Serienkillers befinden, der gerade in Kopenhagen sein Unwesen treibt, verbessert seine Stimmung auch nicht gerade. AuSSerdem strotzt sein bester Freund Jens (Kim Bodnia) nur so vor verruckten Ideen. Neben bizarren Wetten fallen ihm auch noch geschmacklose Streiche ein, die er seinem Kumpel spielen kann. Doch nicht alle beunruhigenden Geschehnisse, die sich in Folge ereignen, lassen sich dadurch erklaren. Und so gerat Martin plotzlich ins Visier von Inspektor Wormer (Ulf Pilgaard), der ihn tatsachlich verdachtigt, der gesuchte Morder zu sein.Das Erstlingswerk des danischen Regisseurs Ole Bornedal war in seiner Heimat der erfolgreichste Kinofilm des Jahres 1994 und avancierte schnell auch international zu einem regelrechten Kultfilm. Bereits drei Jahre spater folgte ein US-Remake mit Ewan McGregor und Nick Nolte in den Hauptrollen, das ebenfalls von Bornedal inszeniert wurde.Exakt dreiSSig Jahre spater prasentierte der Regisseur das Sequel seines Klassikers: In "Nightwatch: Demons Are Forever" wird die Geschichte von Martin weitererzahlt. Und neben Kim Bodnia als Jens und Ulf Pilgaard als Kriminalinspektor ist naturlich auch Nikolaj Coster-Waldau ("Game of Thrones", "Oblivion") in der Hauptrolle wieder mit dabei.

programme.title: Update Uberfallig. How digital is the economy? / Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?
programme.desc: Cover economy, radiohole, outdated software - many medium -sized companies still get problems in digitization in Germany. What is it? But many companies suffer from slow internet, employees have to convey digital know -how - and at the same time face expensive investments. Who prevents progress - and what had to be done for a long time so that Germany's economic engine does not stutter? In the "WISO" documentary "update. ZDF economic expert Florian Neuhann goes to the causes of digital standstill on the basis. Is the main problem in politics? A clear digital strategy was missing for many years. It was only in May this year that the Federal Ministry for Digital was created under the new government - with Karsten Wildberger (CDU) as the first digital minister. A step with symbolic power, but are new tarpaulin and promise? Florian Neuhann meets the minister and investigates whether the digital departure really succeeds - or threatens to fail again on old structures. Too often it said in the past: "We have always done it that way." But rethinking is increasingly taking place - at least since Corona pandemic, medium -sized companies are increasingly investing in digital projects. In 2024 it was almost 32 billion euros. However, large companies in particular benefit. Smaller companies often remain back - they lack resources, personnel and financial planning security to really implement digital projects. The film by Anja Kollruss and Kim Uhlich shows how medium -sized companies are between departure and wait. They accompany companies that feel step forward - and those that are already in the middle of change. The same question arises between technical hurrets, legal uncertainties and limited resources: What does it take so that digitization does not stay a project for a long time - but really arrives in everyday life? In addition to a conversation with Federal Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger, ZDF journalist Florian Neuhann meets this film by manager Julia Jakel, digital expert Aya Jaff and Andrea Thoma-Bock from the "Initiative Zukunftwirtschaft Germany". / Zettelwirtschaft, Funklocher, veraltete Software - viele mittelstandische Unternehmen kampfen in Deutschland noch immer mit Problemen bei der Digitalisierung. Woran liegts?Dabei gelten gerade sie als Ruckgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft. Doch viele Betriebe leiden unter langsamem Internet, mussen Mitarbeitenden digitales Know-how vermitteln - und stehen gleichzeitig vor teuren Investitionen.Warum schreitet die Digitalisierung im Mittelstand so zah voran? Wer verhindert den Fortschritt - und was hatte langst geschehen sein mussen, damit Deutschlands Wirtschaftsmotor nicht ins Stottern kommt? In der "WISO"-Doku "Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?" geht ZDF-Wirtschaftsexperte Florian Neuhann den Ursachen des digitalen Stillstands auf den Grund.Liegt das Hauptproblem in der Politik? Viele Jahre fehlte eine klare Digitalstrategie. Erst im Mai diesen Jahres wurde unter der neuen Regierung das Bundesministerium fur Digitales geschaffen - mit Karsten Wildberger (CDU) als erstem Digitalminister uberhaupt. Ein Schritt mit Symbolkraft, aber reichen neue Plane und Versprechen aus? Florian Neuhann trifft den Minister und geht der Frage nach, ob der digitale Aufbruch nun wirklich gelingt - oder wieder an alten Strukturen zu scheitern droht.Auch viele Unternehmen mussen sich fragen, welchen Anteil sie selbst am schleppenden Tempo haben. Zu oft hieSS es in der Vergangenheit: "Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht." Doch ein Umdenken findet zunehmend statt - spatestens seit der Corona-Pandemie investieren mittelstandische Unternehmen immer mehr in digitale Projekte. 2024 waren es knapp 32 Milliarden Euro. Allerdings profitieren vor allem groSSere Betriebe. Kleinere Unternehmen bleiben oft zuruck - ihnen fehlt es an Ressourcen, Personal und finanzieller Planungssicherheit, um digitale Vorhaben wirklich umzusetzen.Der Film von Anja KollruSS und Kim Uhlich zeigt, wie Mittelstandler zwischen Aufbruch und Abwarten stehen. Sie begleiten Unternehmen, die sich Schritt fur Schritt voran tasten - und solche, die schon mitten im Wandel stecken. Zwischen technischen Hurden, rechtlichen Unsicherheiten und begrenzten Ressourcen stellt sich immer wieder die gleiche Frage: Was braucht es, damit Digitalisierung nicht langer ein Projekt bleibt - sondern wirklich im Alltag ankommt?Die "WISO"-Dokumentation erklart, warum Digitalisierung im deutschen Mittelstand Chance und Herausforderung zugleich bedeutet. Neben einem Gesprach mit dem Bundesdigitalminister Karsten Wildberger trifft ZDF-Journalist Florian Neuhann fur diesen Film die Managerin Julia Jakel, die Digitalexpertin Aya Jaff und Andrea Thoma-Bock von der "Initiative Zukunft Wirtschaft Deutschland".

The novel "Berlin Alexanderplatz" by Alfred Doblin in 1929 is considered one of the main works of German modernity and pays to the most important work that arose at the time of the Weimar Republic. By making and his co-author from the main character Franz Biberkopf made Francis, who has not accepted by the company, address the escape crisis of today and give the film a new scope. Dort will er ein neues Leben beginnen. Er hat sich geschworen, anstandig zu sein, dann begegnet er dem zwielichtigen Drogendealer Reinhold.Ab da gerat er auf die schiefe Bahn. Immer wieder scheitert Francis, schafft es nur muhsam, sich wieder aufzurappeln. Erst die Liebe zur Prostituierten Mieze scheint eine Rettung, bis er endgultig an der Stadt zerbricht und als neuer Mensch wiedergeboren wird.Als Francis, einziger uberlebender Fluchtling einer Überfahrt aus Afrika, an einem Strand in Sudeuropa erwacht, schwort er einen Eid auf den lieben Gott: Von nun an will er ein neuer, besserer und anstandiger Mensch sein.Bald darauf findet sich Francis in Berlin wieder, wo ihm klar wird, wie schwer es ist, rechtschaffen zu sein, wenn man als "illegaler" Flu¨chtling in Deutschland ist - ohne Papiere und ohne Arbeitserlaubnis. Umso verlockender ist das Angebot des charismatischen Deutschen Reinhold, leichtes Geld im Drogendealen zu verdienen. Zunachst widersteht Francis der Versuchung und kampft sich als Schwarzarbeiter auf einer Baustelle am Berliner Alexanderplatz durch. Doch als es dort zu einem blutigen Streit kommt, flieht Francis und findet schlieSSlich bei Reinhold ein neues Zuhause. Die beiden Manner entwickeln eine enge, aber auch zerstorerische Freundschaft. Francis wird Teil von Reinholds Geschaften - und gerat so immer mehr auf die schiefe Bahn.Nachdem Francis seinen linken Arm verliert, gibt er schlieSSlich auf. Da begegnet ihm jedoch die junge Prostituierte Mieze, die ihm nach einem Selbstmordversuch das Leben rettet und ihn bei sich aufnimmt. Die beiden verlieben sich ineinander und als Mieze schwanger wird, beschlieSSt Francis, endgultig anstandig zu werden. Doch abermals kann er dem Charme Reinholds nicht widerstehen, der Francis Gluck nicht ertragen kann. Reinhold totet Mieze und treibt Francis damit fast in den Wahnsinn. Erst jetzt, am Rande der volligen Verzweiflung, erkennt Francis, was er alles falsch gemacht hat.Der 1929 veroffentlichte Roman "Berlin Alexanderplatz" von Alfred Doblin gilt als eines der Hauptwerke der deutschen Moderne und zahlt zu den wichtigsten Arbeiten, die zu Zeiten der Weimarer Republik entstanden sind.Burhan Qurbani hat in diesem deutschen Klassiker eine Parallele zu gesellschaftlichen Strukturen unserer Zeit entdeckt. Indem er und sein Co-Autor aus der Hauptfigur Franz Biberkopf den von der Gesellschaft nicht akzeptierten Fluchtling Francis gemacht haben, thematisieren sie die Fluchtlingskrise der heutigen Zeit und geben dem Film eine neue Tragweite. Der Film feierte seine Premiere im Wettbewerb der Berlinale 2020 und wurde funffach mit dem Deutschen Filmpreis ausgezeichnet, darunter die Lola in Silber fur den besten Spielfilm.

programme.title: Update Uberfallig. How digital is the economy? / Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?
programme.desc: Cover economy, radiohole, outdated software - many medium -sized companies still get problems in digitization in Germany. What is it? But many companies suffer from slow internet, employees have to convey digital know -how - and at the same time face expensive investments. Who prevents progress - and what had to be done for a long time so that Germany's economic engine does not stutter? In the "WISO" documentary "update. ZDF economic expert Florian Neuhann goes to the causes of digital standstill on the basis. Is the main problem in politics? A clear digital strategy was missing for many years. It was only in May this year that the Federal Ministry for Digital was created under the new government - with Karsten Wildberger (CDU) as the first digital minister. A step with symbolic power, but are new tarpaulin and promise? Florian Neuhann meets the minister and investigates whether the digital departure really succeeds - or threatens to fail again on old structures. Too often it said in the past: "We have always done it that way." But rethinking is increasingly taking place - at least since Corona pandemic, medium -sized companies are increasingly investing in digital projects. In 2024 it was almost 32 billion euros. However, large companies in particular benefit. Smaller companies often remain back - they lack resources, personnel and financial planning security to really implement digital projects. The film by Anja Kollruss and Kim Uhlich shows how medium -sized companies are between departure and wait. They accompany companies that feel step forward - and those that are already in the middle of change. The same question arises between technical hurrets, legal uncertainties and limited resources: What does it take so that digitization does not stay a project for a long time - but really arrives in everyday life? In addition to a conversation with Federal Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger, ZDF journalist Florian Neuhann meets this film by manager Julia Jakel, digital expert Aya Jaff and Andrea Thoma-Bock from the "Initiative Zukunftwirtschaft Germany". / Zettelwirtschaft, Funklocher, veraltete Software - viele mittelstandische Unternehmen kampfen in Deutschland noch immer mit Problemen bei der Digitalisierung. Woran liegts?Dabei gelten gerade sie als Ruckgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft. Doch viele Betriebe leiden unter langsamem Internet, mussen Mitarbeitenden digitales Know-how vermitteln - und stehen gleichzeitig vor teuren Investitionen.Warum schreitet die Digitalisierung im Mittelstand so zah voran? Wer verhindert den Fortschritt - und was hatte langst geschehen sein mussen, damit Deutschlands Wirtschaftsmotor nicht ins Stottern kommt? In der "WISO"-Doku "Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?" geht ZDF-Wirtschaftsexperte Florian Neuhann den Ursachen des digitalen Stillstands auf den Grund.Liegt das Hauptproblem in der Politik? Viele Jahre fehlte eine klare Digitalstrategie. Erst im Mai diesen Jahres wurde unter der neuen Regierung das Bundesministerium fur Digitales geschaffen - mit Karsten Wildberger (CDU) als erstem Digitalminister uberhaupt. Ein Schritt mit Symbolkraft, aber reichen neue Plane und Versprechen aus? Florian Neuhann trifft den Minister und geht der Frage nach, ob der digitale Aufbruch nun wirklich gelingt - oder wieder an alten Strukturen zu scheitern droht.Auch viele Unternehmen mussen sich fragen, welchen Anteil sie selbst am schleppenden Tempo haben. Zu oft hieSS es in der Vergangenheit: "Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht." Doch ein Umdenken findet zunehmend statt - spatestens seit der Corona-Pandemie investieren mittelstandische Unternehmen immer mehr in digitale Projekte. 2024 waren es knapp 32 Milliarden Euro. Allerdings profitieren vor allem groSSere Betriebe. Kleinere Unternehmen bleiben oft zuruck - ihnen fehlt es an Ressourcen, Personal und finanzieller Planungssicherheit, um digitale Vorhaben wirklich umzusetzen.Der Film von Anja KollruSS und Kim Uhlich zeigt, wie Mittelstandler zwischen Aufbruch und Abwarten stehen. Sie begleiten Unternehmen, die sich Schritt fur Schritt voran tasten - und solche, die schon mitten im Wandel stecken. Zwischen technischen Hurden, rechtlichen Unsicherheiten und begrenzten Ressourcen stellt sich immer wieder die gleiche Frage: Was braucht es, damit Digitalisierung nicht langer ein Projekt bleibt - sondern wirklich im Alltag ankommt?Die "WISO"-Dokumentation erklart, warum Digitalisierung im deutschen Mittelstand Chance und Herausforderung zugleich bedeutet. Neben einem Gesprach mit dem Bundesdigitalminister Karsten Wildberger trifft ZDF-Journalist Florian Neuhann fur diesen Film die Managerin Julia Jakel, die Digitalexpertin Aya Jaff und Andrea Thoma-Bock von der "Initiative Zukunft Wirtschaft Deutschland".

programme.title: Basketball: Real Madrid - Valencia / Μπάσκετ: Ρεάλ Μαδρίτης - Βαλένθια
programme.desc: ACB LIGA ENDESA 2024-25. 1st final. The leading Spanish basketball championship features European superpowers such as Barcelona, ​​Basconia, Gran Canaria, Unikaha Malaga, as well as the leader Real Madrid. A total of 18 groups claim the title, including the newly enlightened Gida and Coruna. Description: Kyriakos Kouroutsavouris. / ACB Liga Endesa 2024-25. 1ος Τελικός. Το κορυφαίο ισπανικό πρωτάθλημα μπάσκετ διαθέτει ευρωπαϊκές υπερδυνάμεις όπως οι Μπαρτσελόνα, Μπασκόνια, Γκραν Κανάρια, Ουνικάχα Μάλαγα, αλλά και η πρωταθήτρια Ρεάλ Μαδρίτης. Συνολικά 18 ομάδες διεκδικούν τον τίτλο, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των νεοφώτιστων Γέιδα και Κορούνια. Περιγραφή: Κυριάκος Κουρουτσαβούρης.

programme.title: Football: Rayo Vallecano - Thelta (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Ράγιο Βαγιεκάνο - Θέλτα (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Vallecano (13th-4B) suffered a 2-0 away defeat against Osasuna and welcomes La Liga's 5th match (14th-4B), which comes from four consecutive draws. Description: S. Dimolitsa / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Βαγιεκάνο (13η-4β) γνώρισε εκτός έδρας ήττα με 2-0 απέναντι στην Οσασούνα και υποδέχεται για την 5η αγωνιστική της La Liga τη Θέλτα (14η-4β), που προέρχεται από τέσσερις συνεχόμενες ισοπαλίες. Περιγραφή: Σ. Δημολίτσας

programme.title: Football: Majorca - Atletico Madrid (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Μαγιόρκα - Ατλέτικο Μαδρίτης (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Mallorca (19th-1B) has begun the season with three defeats and one draw and welcomes Atletico (11th-5B) in the 5th match, which has achieved its first victory by dominating Villarreal 2-0 inside. Description: G. Papavassiliou / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Μαγιόρκα (19η-1β) έχει ξεκινήσει τη σεζόν με τρεις ήττες και μία ισοπαλία και υποδέχεται στην 5η αγωνιστική την Ατλέτικο (11η-5β), που πέτυχε την πρώτη της νίκη επικρατώντας 2-0 της Βιγιαρεάλ εντός. Περιγραφή: Γ. Παπαβασιλείου

programme.title: Football: Elche - Ovieto (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Έλτσε - Οβιέδο (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Elche (8th-6B) remained unbeaten after a 2-2 draw with Sevilla and hosts La Liga's 5th match (16th-3B) for her 5th La Liga match. Description: T. Bayraktaris / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Έλτσε (8η-6β) παρέμεινε αήττητη μετά την εκτός έδρας ισοπαλία 2-2 με τη Σεβίλλη και υποδέχεται για την 5η αγωνιστική της La Liga την Οβιέδο (16η-3β), που έχασε με 2-0 στην έδρα της Χετάφε. Περιγραφή: Τ. Μπαϊρακτάρης

programme.title: The world of freesports / Ο Κόσμος των Freesports
programme.desc: From surfing and kitesurfing, skiing and snowfall to the Entouro and Canoe-Kayak races, the world of freestyle-Extreme sports is every week with you, full of tension and launching adrenaline! / Από το σέρφινγκ και το kitesurfing, το σκι και την χιονοσανίδα, ως τους αγώνες εντούρο και κανόε-καγιάκ, ο κόσμος των freestyle-extreme σπορ είναι κάθε εβδομάδα κοντά σας, γεμάτος ένταση και εκτοξεύοντας την αδρεναλίνη στα ύψη!

programme.title: Football: Barcelona - Getafe (G) / Ποδόσφαιρο: Μπαρτσελόνα - Χετάφε (Ζ)
programme.desc: La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Barcelona (2nd-10B) hosts Getafe (5th-9B) for the 5th match, with both teams coming from home wins against Valencia 6-0 and Oviedo 2-0 respectively. Description: Is. Prindez / La Liga EA Sports 2025/26. Η Μπαρτσελόνα (2η-10β) υποδέχεται τη Χετάφε (5η-9β) για την 5η αγωνιστική, με τις δύο ομάδες να προέρχονται από εντός έδρας νίκες κόντρα στη Βαλένθια με 6-0 και την Οβιέδο με 2-0 αντίστοιχα. Περιγραφή: Ισ. Πρίντεζης

Orphaned by a child, she raised her younger siblings and in her thirties she marries a consul a larger widow, Dimitros. / Ελληνική κοινωνική σειρά παραγωγής 1980. Η Λωξάντρα ζει στην Κωνσταντινούπολη, στα μέσα του 19ου αιώνα. Ορφανή από παιδί, μεγάλωσε τα μικρότερα αδέλφια της και στα τριάντα της παντρεύεται με προξενιό ένα μεγαλύτερό της χήρο, τον Δημητρό.

programme.title: Backstage (E) / Παρασκήνιο (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Tribute to Nikos Gatsos. Excerpts from his poetry collections are presented, and his friends and associates talk about his work and personality. / Επεισόδιο: Αφιέρωμα στον Νίκο Γκάτσο. Παρουσιάζονται αποσπάσματα από ποιητικές του συλλογές, ενώ φίλοι και συνεργάτες του μιλούν για το έργο και την προσωπικότητά του.

programme.title: A thousand tomorrow E1 (e) / Χίλια Αύριο Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: Condi and Ali are Rodeo's young stars aiming to stand out in the National Championship. Condi would do everything to protect his brother Carl Joseph from his absent father, and Ali is willing to risk everything to stay in the saddle. / Ο Κόντι και η Άλι είναι νεαρά αστέρια του ροντέο που στοχεύουν να διακριθούν στο εθνικό πρωτάθλημα. Ο Κόντι θα έκανε το παν για να προστατεύσει τον αδελφό του Καρλ Τζόζεφ από τον απόντα πατέρα του και η Άλι είναι διατεθειμένη να ρισκάρει τα πάντα για να παραμείνει στη σέλα.

programme.title: A thousand tomorrow E2 (e) / Χίλια Αύριο Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: As Ali's health declined, her determination to continue to struggle attracts Condi's interest. What will her stubbornness to chase her dreams? / Καθώς η υγεία της Άλι φθίνει, η αποφασιστικότητά της να συνεχίζει να αγωνίζεται προσελκύει το ενδιαφέρον του Κόντι. Άραγε, τι θα κοστίσει το πείσμα της να κυνηγήσει τα όνειρά της;

programme.title: Breakfast in the countryside with Jimmy and Sivi E2 / Πρωινό στην Εξοχή με τον Τζίμι και τη Σίβι Ε2
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Danny Wallace. Comedian and writer Danny Wallace comes in a show full of fun. Starting with the gorgeous flamenco eggs, a perfect dish for Brands, Jimmy returns to us where it all started -on his farm with rare breeds of animals. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Ντάνι Γουάλας. Ο κωμικός και συγγραφέας Ντάνι Γουάλας έρχεται σε μια εκπομπή γεμάτη διασκέδαση. Αρχίζοντας με τα υπέροχα αβγά φλαμένκο, ένα τέλειο πιάτο για μπραντς, ο Τζίμι μάς γυρίζει εκεί απ όπου ξεκίνησαν όλα -στη φάρμα του με σπάνιες φυλές ζώων.

programme.title: Those who took the mountains (e) / Αυτοί που Πήραν τα Βουνά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Nonda and organic products in Kilkis. When Nondas met Zoumboulia's wife, they made the decision to move to the wife of the wife, Kilkis, for a more comfortable and human life. They opened the first and only organic store today in the city. / Επεισόδιο: Ο Νώντας και τα βιολογικά προϊόντα στο Κιλκίς. Όταν ο Νώντας γνώρισε τη γυναίκα του Ζουμπουλιά πήραν την απόφαση να μετοικήσουν στα πάτρια εδάφη της συζύγου, στο Κιλκίς, για μια πιο άνετη και ανθρώπινη ζωή. Άνοιξαν το πρώτο και μοναδικό σήμερα κατάστημα βιολογικών προϊόντων στην πόλη.

programme.title: Handball: Athenian - Zafirakis Naoussa (G) / Χάντμπολ: Αθηναϊκός - Ζαφειράκης Νάουσας (Ζ)
programme.desc: Greek Handball Premier. 1st race. With the participation of 12 teams this year the Greek handball team championships are held. The Trophy Holder for 2025 is Olympiacos. / Greek Handball Premier. 1η Αγωνιστική. Με τη συμμετοχή 12 ομάδων διεξάγεται και φέτος το πρωτάθλημα της κορυφαίας κατηγορίας του ελληνικού χάντμπολ. Κάτοχος του τροπαίου για το 2025 είναι ο Ολυμπιακός.

programme.title: Mediterranean E2 (E) / Μεσόγειος Ε2 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Sarajevo. The Ottoman character of the city is widespread on the streets and buildings, but Sarajevo is a true mosaic of history. Among other things, the show meets Amira Mentianin, today's voice of Sevdelidic songs and the Pontanima choir. / Επεισόδιο: Σεράγεβο. Ο οθωμανικός χαρακτήρας της πόλης είναι διάχυτος στους δρόμους και στα κτήρια, όμως το Σεράγεβο είναι ένα πραγματικό μωσαϊκό της ιστορίας. Μεταξύ άλλων, η εκπομπή συναντά την Αμίρα Μεντούνιανιν, τη σημερινή φωνή των σεβντελίδικων τραγουδιών και τη χορωδία Pontanima.

programme.title: The music of the world (e) / Οι Μουσικές του Κόσμου (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Yiannis Angelakas - Alltogether Now. The music of the world attempts a colorful musical journey from traditional sounds and exotic rhythms, to e -sounds and experimental musical approaches. / Επεισόδιο: Γιάννης Αγγελάκας - Alltogether Now. Οι Μουσικές του κόσμου, επιχειρούν ένα πολύχρωμο μουσικό ταξίδι από παραδοσιακούς ήχους και εξωτικούς ρυθμούς, μέχρι ηλεκτρονικά ακούσματα και πειραματικές μουσικές προσεγγίσεις.

programme.title: Marshall: In the shadow of the law / Marshall: Στη Σκιά του Νόμου
programme.desc: In the 40's, Thegud Marshall is a young lawyer who defends innocent African Americans who have been unjustly accused. One of Thegud's first trials was the case of a African -American named Joseph Sepl, who was unjustly accused of rape and attempted murder. (120) / Την δεκαετία του 40, ο Θέργκουντ Μάρσαλ είναι ένας νεαρός δικηγόρος που υπερασπίζεται αθώους Αφροαμερικανούς που έχουν κατηγορηθεί άδικα. Μια από τις πρώτες δίκες του Θέργκουντ ήταν η υπόθεση ενός Αφροαμερικανού ονόματι Τζόσεφ Σπελ, που κατηγορήθηκε άδικα για βιασμό και απόπειρα δολοφονίας. (120)

programme.title: Coyote E1 (E) / Coyote Ε1 (Ε)
programme.desc: On the last day at work as a border guard, Ben Clemens discovers a secret tunnel used for the smuggling of goods in the United States from Mexico. / Την τελευταία μέρα στη δουλειά ως συνοριοφύλακας, ο Μπεν Κλέμενς ανακαλύπτει μια μυστική σήραγγα που χρησιμοποιείται για τη λαθραία εισαγωγή εμπορευμάτων στις Ηνωμένες Πολιτείες από το Μεξικό.

programme.desc: Researchers, university professors, who dealt with the great Cretan and worldwide creator, as well as ordinary everyday people, tell stories that lived and listened, outlining his life and work. / Ερευνητές, καθηγητές πανεπιστημίου, που ασχολήθηκαν με τον μεγάλο Κρητικό και παγκόσμιο δημιουργό, αλλά και απλοί καθημερινοί άνθρωποι, αφηγούνται ιστορίες που έζησαν και άκουσαν, σκιαγραφώντας τη ζωή και το έργο του.

Στη συνέχεια, ταξιδεύουμε στη Χώρα Μεσσηνίας, όπου μαθαίνουμε για την Ομάδα Παραγωγών Νηλέας και τη δράση της.

programme.desc: I. Skordalos-My Lyre Friends. Σκορδαλός-Της Λύρας μου οι Φίλοι. Μιλάμε με τη σαξοφωνίστρια Μελίνα Παξινού και με τον διάσημο πιανίστα, Γιώργο Κοντραφούρη.

programme.title: The altar of Pergamon, a looted monument (e) / O Βωμός της Περγάμου, Ένα Λεηλατημένο Μνημείο (Ε)
programme.desc: In 1864, a German engineer discovered the ruins of a lost miracle of the world, the altar of Pergamon, to the west of the Ottoman Empire. Berlin wanted what was left for its museum island. And he got it! / Το 1864, ένας Γερμανός μηχανικός ανακάλυψε τα ερείπια ενός χαμένου θαύματος του κόσμου, του Βωμού της Περγάμου, στα δυτικά της Οθωμανικής Αυτοκρατορίας. Το Βερολίνο ήθελε ό,τι είχε απομείνει για το Νησί των Μουσείων του. Και το πήρε!

programme.title: My name is Elias Kazan / Το Όνομά μου Είναι Ελία Καζάν
programme.desc: PREMIERE. 1972: Kazan presents his latest film, visitors, in Cannes. Andre Lambart decide to follow him in the US ... 2017: Lamcart decides to shoot a film with these anecdotal interviews. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. 1972: Ο Καζάν παρουσιάζει την τελευταία του ταινία, Οι Επισκέπτες, στις Κάννες. Ο Αντρέ Λαμπάρτ αποφασίζουν να τον ακολουθήσουν στις ΗΠΑ... 2017: Ο Λαμπάρτ αποφασίζει να γυρίσει μια ταινία με αυτές τις ανέκδοτες συνεντεύξεις.

programme.title: Nationwide / Πανελλήνιον
programme.desc: PREMIERE. A story of ghosts about obsession, loneliness and madness, in a chess coffee shop out of place and time, in downtown Athens: This is the story of the Panhellenic. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Μια ιστορία φαντασμάτων για την εμμονή, τη μοναξιά και την τρέλα, σε ένα σκακιστικό καφενείο εκτός τόπου και χρόνου, στο κέντρο της Αθήνας: αυτή είναι η ιστορία για το Πανελλήνιον.

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: The armchair on the sidewalk. A song brings youthful memories to an elderly retired retired dementia. Ένα τραγούδι ανασύρει νεανικές μνήμες σε έναν ηλικιωμένο συνταξιούχο που πάσχει από άνοια. Λαχταρώντας να επανακτήσει την ανεξαρτησία του, φεύγει από το σπίτι κρυφά από τη σύζυγό του, αψηφώντας τις οδηγίες του γιατρού.

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: The house on Pagalou Street. programme.desc: I. Skordalos-My Lyre Friends. Σκορδαλός-Της Λύρας μου οι Φίλοι. Επιδέξιος λυράρης, συνθέτης και στιχουργός µε δεκάδες επιτυχίες, ο Θανάσης Σκορδαλός, άνοιξε νέους δρόμους στη μουσική έκφραση και στο λαϊκό Κρητικό ιδίωμα και επηρέασε καθοριστικά το σύνολο των δημιουργών του νησιού.

programme.title: Islands on the edge E3 (e) / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Archo. A short distance from the Turkish coasts and near Patmos, there is a cluster of small islands belonging to the Dodecanese. Σε μικρή απόσταση από τις τουρκικές ακτές και κοντά στην Πάτμο, υπάρχει ένα σύμπλεγμα μικρών νησιών που ανήκουν στα Δωδεκάνησα. Σε αυτήν τη μικροσκοπική και άγνωστη Πολυνησία ανήκουν και οι Αρκιοί.

programme.title: Sunday in the village again (e) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε)

Πρωταγωνιστής παραμένει το χωριό, οι άνθρωποι που το κατοικούν, οι ζωές τους, ο τρόπος που αναπαράγουν τις παραδόσεις τους, όλα όσα έχουν πετύχει μέσα στο χρόνο κι όλα όσα ονειρεύονται.

programme.title: Overheating in the Mediterranean (E) / Υπερθέρμανση στη Μεσόγειο (Ε)
programme.desc: The program presents the deep changes brought about by global warming in the Mediterranean, the sea described as Oinop Pontos, and in the surrounding areas. / Το πρόγραμμα παρουσιάζει τις βαθιές αλλαγές που έφερε η υπερθέρμανση του πλανήτη στη Μεσόγειο, τη θάλασσα που περιέγραψε ως Οίνωψ Πόντος ο Όμηρος, και στις γύρω περιοχές.

Μιλάμε με τη σαξοφωνίστρια Μελίνα Παξινού και με τον διάσημο πιανίστα, Γιώργο Κοντραφούρη.

programme.desc: In 1864, a German engineer discovered the ruins of a lost miracle of the world, the altar of Pergamon, to the west of the Ottoman Empire. Το Βερολίνο ήθελε ό,τι είχε απομείνει για το Νησί των Μουσείων του. Και το πήρε!

Αλλά ο παράδεισος των εκατομμυριούχων ήρθε σε ρήξη με το κραχ του 1929, που οδήγησε τις ΗΠΑ στη Μεγάλη Ύφεση.

programme.title: Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Real Madrid vs Espanyol - Spanish LaLiga 2025/26 - Week 5
programme.desc: Real Madrid have won 24 and drawn three of their last 27 home games against Espanyol in LaLiga, winning the last 10, the best unbeaten run and winning streak at home against Espanyol in their history in the competition. Espanyol have lost 108 of their 178 matches against Real Madrid in LaLiga, the highest number of defeats suffered by any team against another in the history of the competition.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Chelsea - English Premier League 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Manchester United are unbeaten in their last 12 Premier League home games against Chelsea since a 0-1 defeat in May 2013. Indeed, Chelsea’s win rate of 18% at Old Trafford in the Premier League is their lowest away to any side they have visited 10+ times in the competition. After their 1-0 win in May, Chelsea are looking for successive league victories over Manchester United for the first time since winning three in a row from November 2009 to March 2011 under Carlo Ancelotti. The Blues’ two wins in their last three league games versus the Red Devils are as many as their previous 17 beforehand.

programme.title: Brest vs Nice - French Ligue 1 2025/2026 Week 5
programme.desc: Brest have won only one of their last nine matches against Nice in Ligue 1, a 1-0 success on April 16, 2023 at Francis-Le Ble. It was also the last time that the Bretons managed to score a goal against Les Aiglons in the top-flight. programme.title: Practice 2 - F1 Qatar Airways Azerbaijan Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The most representative 60-minute session for race prep. Squads refine power-unit modes, test fuel-corrected long runs, and tune drag vs. downforce for the 6.003 km layout. Focus: brake stability into Turn 1, traction through the infield, and ERS deployment for overtakes. Data here frames tyre choice and pit windows for Sunday.

programme.title: Montpellier vs Chambery - LNH Division 1 - French Handball Starligue
programme.desc: Dive into the excitement of French handball with Liqui Moly Starligue, formerly LNH Division 1. Established in 1952, this premier league event features 16 top teams battling for glory. With Montpellier’s 14 Handball titles and Paris Saint-Germains 11 wins, the competition is fierce. Champions earn spots in the EHF Champions League, while cup winners qualify for the European League.

programme.desc: The Qatari League is the official football league in Qatar. The league includes 12 teams. programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Petrovic Vs Kalaba / Borilački sport - MMA: Petrovic vs Kalaba
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 316 / MMA UFC 316
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Argentine League: Atletico Tucuman - River Plate / Fudbal - Argentinska liga: Atletico Tucuman - River Plate
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom established its football league is Argentina. programme.title: Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart Bet - FMP Soccerbet, G3 / Košarka - KLS: Partizan Mozzart bet - FMP Soccerbet, G3
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Fudbal - Liga Evrope
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Bahcesehir - Fenerbahce / Košarka - Turska liga: Bahcesehir - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The beginnings of the Turkish basketball dwell back before the League founding in 1966. years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams playing each with every twice in the regular part after which the plejof is the eight best teams. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G3 / Košarka - Euroleague: Barcelona - Monaco, G3
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that started its journey into the world of European basketball under the name Cup of European Champions in 1958. years, and the first trophy won the KSK Riga team from the then USSR and today's Latvia. The FIBA ​​led the main word in this competition until 2000. when clubs took control of the competition through its Euregation Basketball Association. The format of the competition changed through history and contained a part of the groups after which elimations in the playoffs followed. The winner of this competition decides on the final tournament called Final Four. The most successful clubs of this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathianos, Varese, Olympiacos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - French League: Lyon - Monaco, semifinals G2 / Košarka - Francuska liga: Lyon - Monaco, polufinale G2
programme.desc: The competition of the highest rank of club basketball in France is called LNB Pro A. League was founded in 1921. that changed its name throughout history. Nakon 34 odigrana kola osam najboljih ekipa ulazi u plej of i borbu za titulu prvaka Francuske. Ekipa sa najviše osvojenih titula je ASVEL.

programme.title: Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: Youth sports games are the largest manifestation for children and youth in this area, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. Under the slogan, we live life without drugs, because the drugs are taking life, the basics in Serbia, we provide completely free participation in competitions, in ten sports disciplines and the most successful individuals and teams travel to free international games in Split. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: We live for basketball / Mi živimo za košarku
programme.desc: Go with us on the trip and find out more about domestic basketball clubs that do their best to achieve the best possible placement in the leagues they compete. / Pođite sa nama na putovanje i saznajte nešto više o domaćim košarkaškim klubovima koji daju sve od sebe kako bi ostvarili što bolji plasman u ligama u kojima se takmiče.

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Fighter - worker / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Borac - Radnik
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. programme.title: Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake devotes a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: Kontejnerske vojne: Osem ton zabave

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Memories: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 3. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 3. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.title: We use wood, part 6. / Uporabimo les, 6. del, izobraževalno-dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: Use wood, 6. Part; Wood is not just a building material. With it, we bring nature into our home and it is proven that wood improves well -being and productivity. Wood offers development opportunities for businesses and individuals and is a strategic material of our country, which makes Slovenia ranks among the three most forested European countries. Let's listen to the inspiring stories of people who passionately believe in the charm of wood and see the material of the future, an opportunity for economic development and the preservation of the environment for future generations. / Uporabimo Les, 6. Del; Les ni le gradbeni material. Z njim vnašamo naravo v svoj dom in dokazano je, da les izboljšuje počutje in storilnost. Les ponuja razvojne priložnosti tako podjetjem kot posameznikom in je strateški material naše države, zaradi katerega se Slovenija uvršča med tri najbolj gozdnate evropske države. Prisluhnimo navdihujočim zgodbam ljudi, ki strastno verjamejo v čar lesa in v njem vidijo material prihodnosti, priložnost za gospodarski razvoj in ohranitev okolja za prihodnje generacije.

The concert will premiere on TV Slovenia in two parts. / Na ekrane prihaja razprodani koncert Siddharte, posnet 18. novembra 2023 v ljubljanski Areni Stožice. 30 let po legendarnem koncertu na bežigrajskem stadionu in izidu albuma Rh-. Navdušujoč program, ki traja skoraj tri ure in pol, vsebuje največje uspešnice in tudi pesmi najnovejšega albuma X. Koncert bo premierno na TV Slovenija predvajan v dveh delih.

programme.title: Young virtuosos: cellist Ema Krečič / Mladi virtuozi: violončelistka Ema Krečič
programme.desc: R: Bastič Aljaž ... In the Studio of Television Slovenia, with selected works, young musicians present themselves in their study path and warn themselves with excellent performances. After graduation at the Academy of Music in Ljubljana, cellist Ema Krečič completes her knowledge at the Mozarteum University of Salzburg. With the piano accompaniment of Alvin Ćućić, she introduced herself with the performance of Rahmanin's vocalis and dancing of the green devil of Spanish composer Gaspar Cassado, and played an interesting work of contemporary Sicilian composer Giovannni Sollime on the stage. / R: Bastič Aljaž... V studiu Televizije Slovenija se z izbranimi deli predstavljajo mladi glasbeniki, ki na svoji študijski poti dosegajo izjemne uspehe in opozarjajo nase z odličnimi nastopi. Violončelistka Ema Krečič po končanem študiju na Akademiji za glasbo v Ljubljani svoje znanje izpopolnjuje na salzburški glasbeni univerzi Mozarteum. Ob klavirski spremljavi Alvina Ćućića se je predstavila z izvedbo Rahmaninove Vokalize in Plesa zelenega vraga španskega skladatelja Gasparja Cassadoja, sama pa je na odru zaigrala še zanimivo delo sodobnega sicilijanskega skladatelja Giovannija Sollime.

programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambients; The young couple created their dream home in a new building in the charming Bled. The path from finding the ideal location to the final arrangement of the home was not short, but the home now fully reflects their wishes for comfort and aesthetics. We get to know how they are facing / Ambienti; Mlad par si je ustvaril svoj sanjski dom v novogradnji na očarljivem Bledu. Pot od iskanja idealne lokacije do končne ureditve doma ni bila kratka, vendar dom zdaj popolnoma odraža njune želje po udobju in estetiki. Spoznamo, kako sta se sooča
programme.desc: We show an apartment in Portorož that goes beyond the boundaries of countries and combines people with a vision of beauty and harmony. The background of harmonious chaos consists of artistic pieces from all over the world - from Iran and Uzbekistan all the way to local antiques. The owner explains how she succeeded in subtly combining the stories of the past with modernity and what role her partner plays. Although dry meadows above the Karst edge are considered to be the most colorful collection of meadow flowers, just below it is a beautiful garden, completely hidden from the rare visitors of the village of Podpeč. His creator kindly received us and took us around her stone home, surrounded by dehuminous roses, fruit trees and countless flowers. / Pokažemo stanovanje v Portorožu, ki presega meje držav ter združuje ljudi z vizijo lepote in harmonije. Ozadje harmoničnega kaosa sestavljajo umetniški kosi z vseh koncev sveta - od Irana in Uzbekistana pa vse do lokalnih starinarnic. Lastnica razloži, kako ji je uspelo subtilno združiti zgodbe preteklosti s sodobnostjo in kakšno vlogo pri tem igra njen partner.Čeprav veljajo suhi travniki nad Kraškim robom za najbolj pisano zbirko travniških cvetlic, se tik pod njim skriva čudovit vrt, povsem skrit očem redkih obiskovalcev vasi Podpeč. Njegova ustvarjalka nas je prijazno sprejela in popeljala okoli svojega kamnitega doma, obdanega z dehtečimi vrtnicami, sadnimi drevesi in neštetimi cvetovi.

programme.sub-title: The Wonders of Europe / Leurope des Mervilles II; The second season of the documentary series of the Wonder Europe reveals the history of four unique European landmarks: the Eiffel Tower, the Flores Cathedral, the Roman Pantheon and the magnificent Schonbrunn mansion on / The Wonders Of Europe / Leurope Des Merveilles Ii.; Druga sezona dokumentarne serije Čudesa Evrope razkriva zgodovino štirih edinstvenih evropskih znamenitosti: Eifflovega stolpa, firenške stolnice, rimskega Panteona in veličastnega dvorca Schonbrunn na
programme.desc: Part 3.: Florence Cathedral - A Sciences Renaissasetreti Delo reveals the stunning history of one of the most famous churches of all time, the Florence Cathedral. In 1418, a competition for the construction of the largest dome, which the world has seen before, were announced in Florence. The cathedral in this famous city, the then economic capital of Europe, has been an unfinished for over a hundred years. This shameful conundrum was finally dismissed by Filippo Brunelleschi, after which the greatest masters later looked at Leonardo Da Vinci and Michelangelo. Initially, a completely unknown genius created one of the greatest cultural treasures of all time, the mighty dome of the Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral, which is still admired by the whole world today.The Wonders of Europe II. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Dominique Fargues. / 3. del: Firenška stolnica – znanilka renesanseTretji del razkriva osupljivo zgodovino ene najznamenitejših cerkva vseh časov, firenške stolnice. Leta 1418 so v Firencah razpisali natečaj za gradnjo največje kupole, kar jih je dotlej videl svet. Stolnica v tem slovitem mestu, tedanji gospodarski prestolnici Evrope, je namreč že več kot sto let stala nedokončana. To sramotno zagato je nazadnje razrešil Filippo Brunelleschi, po katerem so se pozneje zgledovali največji mojstri, vključno z Leonardom da Vincijem in Michelangelom. Sprva še povsem neznani genij je ustvaril enega največjih kulturnih zakladov vseh časov, mogočno kupolo katedrale Santa Maria del Fiore, ki jo še danes občuduje ves svet.THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Dominique Fargues.

programme.title: Aigues fosques
programme.desc: An Ohio environmental lawyer embarks on a trial against a chemical company that is contaminating the drinking water of a small city.In 1998, lawyer Robert Bilott received the call from a farmer whose cattle had begun to die in strange circumstances. Two years later, man made one of the most transcendental decisions of his life: to sue the almighty company Dupont, of which he suspected that he was the cause of these deaths. Bilott ended up uncovering a contamination case that covered several decades and became a reference for a society increasingly concerned about ecology. / Un abogado ambientalista de Ohio se embarca en un juicio contra una empresa química que está contaminando el agua potable de una pequeña ciudad.En 1998, el abogado Robert Bilott recibio la llamada de un granjero cuyo ganado había empezado a morir en extrañas circunstancias. Dos años despues, el hombre tomo una de las decisiones más trascendentales de su vida: demandar a la todopoderosa empresa DuPont, de la que sospechaba que era la causante de dichas muertes. Bilott acabo destapando un caso de contaminacion que abarcaba varias decadas y se convirtio en un referente para una sociedad cada vez más preocupada por la ecología.

programme.title: Viudes
programme.desc: Four women with nothing in common, except the debt inherited by the criminal activities of their deceased husbands, decide to take the reins of their destination and conspire to force a future with their own rules. On this occasion, the filmmaker moves the action of the London from the early 80s to the contemporary Chicago to tell a story about four women of different levels - racial, social and economic - that join forces to achieve a common goal. / Cuatro mujeres sin nada en común, excepto la deuda heredada por las actividades criminales de sus difuntos maridos, deciden tomar las riendas de su destino y conspiran para forjarse un futuro con sus propias reglas.Cinco años despues de ganar el Oscar con 12 años de esclavitud, Steve McQueen estreno este thriller dramático basado en la serie de television británica de 1983 Las viudas. En esta ocasion, el realizador traslada la accion del Londres de principios de los 80 al Chicago contemporáneo para narrar una historia sobre cuatro mujeres de distintos estamentos -racial, social y economico- que unen fuerzas para conseguir un objetivo común.

programme.desc: The capital of Japan hosts one of the sports events of the year. From September 13 to 21, Tokyo houses the athletics World Cup dispute. programme.desc: One of the most prestigious events of the Squash World Tour, being considered a diamond category event by the PSA World Tour. programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, many legends have recounted the origin of the name of Taormina, this splendid town with the "thousand beauties" founded in 358 BC. C. On Mount Tauron by some Greeks from Naxos, one of the oldest Greek colonies on the island. From this colony, the inhabitants of Tauromenium were culturally influenced so as to build, at that time, the famous ancient theater, now a symbol of the city. But in addition to the panoramic views, breathtaking inlets and luxuriant flora, Taormina is much more: among the alleys and buildings there are architectural monuments of particular beauty, testimonies of the various dominations that, over the centuries, have created the history of the city, such as the Roman, Arab and Bourbon. Today as yesterday, however, it seems that it is the majestic Etna who stands out in front of the town who govern on the fate of men. / Fin dalla notte dei tempi, molte leggende raccontano l´origine del nome di Taormina, questa splendida cittadina dalle "mille bellezze" fondata nel 358 a. C. sul Monte Tauron da alcuni greci provenienti da Naxos, una delle più antiche colonie greche dell´isola. Da questa colonia, gli abitanti di Tauromenium furono culturalmente influenzati tanto da costruire, in quel periodo, il famoso Teatro Antico, ormai simbolo della città. Ma oltre agli scorci panoramici, alle insenature mozzafiato e alla flora rigogliosa, Taormina è molto di più: tra le viuzze e i palazzi d´epoca si scorgono monumenti architettonici di particolare bellezza, testimonianze delle varie dominazioni che, nel corso dei secoli, hanno creato la storia della città, come quella romana, araba e borbonica. Oggi come ieri, però, sembra che sia il maestoso Etna che si staglia davanti alla cittadina a governare sul destino degli uomini.

programme.title: NZZ Standpunkte
programme.sub-title: Ferner Frieden: Der Ukraine-Krieg im Realitatscheck
programme.desc: Donald Trump does not seem to leave anything to be unexpected to make progress in the negotiations for peace in the Ukraine War. He even puts Selenski in front of his head - and Putin is rolling out the red carpet. In all this, the threats and misunderstandings, the speech of security guarantees and arms deliveries, even the reality on the ground is neglected. What about the forces along the long contact line? What negotiation tactics does the Kremlin always look at - and how does that become out of the question in the present negotiations? And what kind of possibilities does Kyiv have to make peace for himself? These are some of the questions that were able to determine the progress of the events despite all the waves of the White House. The “NZZ” editor-in-chief Eric Gujer speaks to him about the negotiations in the Ukraine War. / Donald Trump scheint nichts unversucht zu lassen, um in den Verhandlungen fur einen Frieden im Ukraine-Krieg Fortschritte zu erzielen. Er stosst dazu sogar Selenski vor den Kopf – und rollt Putin den roten Teppich aus.Bei all dem Hin und Her, den Drohungen und Missverstandnissen, der Rede von Sicherheitsgarantien und Waffenlieferungen, kommt sogar die Realitat am Boden zu kurz. Wie etwa steht es um die Krafteverhaltnisse entlang der langen Kontaktlinie? Auf welche Verhandlungstaktiken greift der Kreml immer wieder zuruck – und wie aussert sich das in den gegenwartigen Verhandlungen? Und welche Moglichkeiten hat Kiew, den Frieden fur sich zu entscheiden? Das sind einige der Fragen, die trotz allen Bemuhungen des Weissen Hauses den Fortgang der Ereignisse bestimmen durften.Nico Lange ist Senior Fellow der Munchner Sicherheitskonferenz und deutscher Politologe. Der «NZZ»-Chefredaktor Eric Gujer spricht mit ihm uber die Verhandlungen im Ukraine-Krieg.
